intro: Hey hey! It's the Paws and Claws Club!
Uh oh, we're muddy! Bath time!
chorus: Scrub a dub, rub a dub, one, two, three,
Squeaky clean for you and me!
verses: Rory's mane is full of mud,
Scrub, scrub, scrub with lots of suds!
Now Rory's mane is fluffy instead!
But she tries a little scrub!
Paws in first, one, two, three,
Ziggy's brave as brave can be!
Waffles jumps in with a splash,
Waffles is the cleanest pup there were!
He floats around just like a boat!
bridge: Wash your face! Wash, wash, wash!
Wash your paws! Wash, wash, wash!
Wash your tummy! Wash, wash, wash!
Wash your toes! Splish, splash, splosh!
